protocol.selection: fixed top connections from discovery JSON; no reselection
protocol.holdout: new item combinations; original 240 seed-0 items excluded
protocol.edit: simultaneous head-mean deviation scaling; pred/corr/both separated
protocol.controls: random heads; same layer/stream/source counts; L2 norm matched per layer/token on incoming activations
protocol.intervals: normal approximation to paired item/sequence mean differences
